entities.summary: Shlomi Shabat (b. 1954-08-30, Yehud) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yehud and Israel. Known in the fields of israel, composers & musicians, asia.
